description: List all available pre-reasoned market briefings with tier requirements. Returns 32 LIVE briefings across Free (6), Basic (13), and Pro (13) tiers, plus the company briefing (equities.company), one listed company per call, for the US on Basic and above (3,002 US company briefings as of 2026-10-07), for Japan on Pro and above (1,546 Japanese company briefings as of 2026-10-06), for Korea on Pro and above (2,533 Korean company briefings as of 2026-10-07), and for India on Pro and above (232 Indian company briefings as of 2026-10-07). Covers macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, listed companies, cross-asset and Bitcoin. Pass search with the question's words to get only the briefings that match, best first; when it names a company, the answer also lists the matching covered companies, each with the entity to pass to get_context. No authentication required.

search.description: The question or its key words (for example "is the yield curve inverted" or "Toyota earnings"). Returns the matching briefings, best first, at most five, and any covered companies it names (at most five).

tier.description: Filter briefings by subscription tier (free, basic, or pro). Returns all tiers if omitted.
